item.title: No charges against driver who fatally struck Ocala student walking to school bus
item.description: The Ocala Police Department has officially closed its investigation into an accident that claimed the life of 18-year-old Forest High School senior Shannon Rushing as she was walking to her school bus stop, determining that no criminal charges will be filed against the driver. item.title: We can’t afford our property taxes in Marion County
item.description: "I live in JB ranch, purchased in July 2024. I am 82 years old and live on Social Security, plus a few small investments. My tax bill is almost $4,000. My monthly income is roughly $2,500. This covers utilities, food, gas, HOA fees, etc. My taxes are out of control and ridiculous. My house is for sale since I no longer wish to live in Marion County." - Several local residents shared opinions about property taxes. Read more: We can’t afford our property taxes in Marion County
